description: QRise API lets you create, manage, and track QR codes programmatically.

sections.title: What you can do
items: Create and manage QR codes (url, smart routing, password, multi-action)
Update target URLs on the fly without reprinting (Dynamic QRs)
Set up Smart Routing rules to redirect based on device, location, time
Track scan analytics with bot filtering
Generate QR codes in bulk from CSV data

sections.title: REST API
sections.content: The QRise API is REST-based with JSON request and response bodies. All endpoints require authentication via an API key in the Authorization header.
